source: University of Waterloo Undergraduate Studies Calendar — Degree Requirements for all Math students, Table 1
label: Four-Year Honours
notes: Courses with the subject code COOP, PD and WKRPT do not count toward the minimum course units.
A course cross-listed with a math course counts as a math course whichever code it was taken under.
Co-op plans additionally require 2.5 COOP units and 2.5 PD units, which TrackR does not track.
